info.name: DataConnect — Flows (transforms→schema→quality→pipelines→lifecycle→lineage→exec→drift→monitoring)
info.description:
End-to-end, dependency-ordered tests. Run folders top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner; test scripts chain ids through collection variables.

Base URL prefix is /api/v1/dataconnect. Org header X-Org-Id=org_1001 on org-scoped routes (connector-templates, schemas/infer and monitoring need NO org header).

Order: 0 Setup -> 1 Transform -> 2 Schema -> 3 Quality -> 4 Pipelines -> 5 Lifecycle -> 6 Lineage (needs a deploy) -> 7 Quality Execution -> 8 Schema Drift -> 9 Monitoring.

Each folder includes positive cases for every endpoint, all enum possibilities, and NEG- prefixed negative cases (400/404/409/422).
